proposed_capability: P95: a bounded click-outcome and camera-context feedback learning seam, with positive clicks only for independently verified intended postconditions, negative clicks for verified unintended outcomes or agent-caused camera-context loss, and unknown evidence abstention. Record newly discovered targets as provisional atlas candidates. Compute patch/scene/target contextual exponentially-discounted Beta-Bernoulli statistics and bounded event history from opt-in agent/host/game/operator observations; derive bounded polling-to-signal camera anomalies without new hooks/daemons. P124: reuse click_error_eval, sim_camera, camera_traverse, ui_microsystems, screen_atlas and host_listener one session sidecar; no new Win32 input owner. Trifecta: P82 measured offline regression tests, P07 PR/merge after CI, P08 later local physical game proof.
player_save_control_impact: Explicit opt-in and session scope only. No raw inputs, save file reads/writes, screenshot storage, synthetic gameplay approval, auto-calibration, unknown-target input, forced click, auto-retry, always-on poller, webhooks claimed against native Sims, external network calls, user identity storage, or player camera override. Feedback never grants screen input authority or demotes a player-origin deliberate zoom to error.
expected_outcome: A schema-backed host feedback catalog, bounded opt-in event ingestion and contextual Beta-Bernoulli statistics with unknown abstention, candidate-only discovery map, camera anomaly planning reusing Enter/Shift+Enter/observed safe zoom/rotation only, a pure polling transition detector, host_listener active-session sidecar integration, negative/regression suite and durable ledger/source docs. Live-game P08 remains open; BI-002 hunger unchanged.
negative_tests: Geometric hit without intended result is not positive
Intended verified result and hit are positive
Wrong target/actual unintended result is negative with independent evidence
Insufficient or contradictory sources remain untrained
Wrong patch/mode, out-of-order time, malformed event, over-budget state fail closed
Player-intended zoom is not classified as harmful
Agent edge-pan/zoom-out context loss is negative and yields gated recovery advice
Unmapped target never becomes executable from statistics or discovery
No raw capture, unapproved automation, direct Win32 or live gameplay assertions
Opt-in host sidecar cannot write outside session or mutate inactive session
Existing screen_atlas, hover, and Playwright adapters remain unchanged
rollback_path: Revert feature PR; leave old camera, click_error, click atlas, hover and native input owners unmodified or behavior-preserved. Session sidecar is disposable under dist; never stored outside user-owned canonical session.
unresolved_unknowns: Native game callback/poll source freshness and exact UI label sensors must be certified on local host
Observed zoom and rotate input bindings require exact-patch proof before any dispatch
Live postcondition cues and camera scale classification need P08 game-specific data
Self-supervised labels can be noisy; keep unknown class and require proof, never convert posterior into click permit
